lxc_a2680159231b9197.text: First, we look at what Minecraft is and why it has no required goals.

lxc_f3db95472f93b544.text: Then we see how Markus Persson made the first version, and how the game grew from 2009 to 2011.

lxc_7f135d4ce5a6b2b5.text: After that, we look at Microsoft buying Mojang in 2014.

lxc_0c6301ef7db56de5.text: Finally, we ask why Minecraft is the best-selling video game, and what we really know about it.

lxc_7fe741ea69dd1458.text: Most video games give you a clear goal.

lxc_73d42937340c2311.text: In a racing game, you must win the race.

lxc_fa8606cc0075c200.text: Nobody tells you what to do.

lxc_114a36f10a6c6e9f.text: You can build a house, explore a valley, or just walk around.

lxc_0be6625a34be10a9.text: There are no goals that you must reach.

lxc_b445783fbe424192.text: Some players build big structures from blocks.

lxc_ce1235f8b3dc2ab5.text: Some players craft things, which means they make new items from simple materials.

lxc_b1fc826060abec4c.text: In survival play, you must also stay alive.

lxc_61cec051cb72fb13.text: In creative play, you can simply build what you want.

lxc_b4a11ada81f9489f.text: This is like a box of toy bricks.

lxc_77a7b3ca60400002.text: The box does not tell you what to make.

lxc_170d6a2bdb8fef78.text: The bricks only give you the pieces.

lxc_2eb5b6de19de9ef8.text: In the same way, Minecraft gives you a world and lets you choose.

lxc_1e6b0612cba4a04d.text: So the game is not one activity.

lxc_d5262750a16d1164.text: It is many possible activities in one place.

lxc_1280714af4c00848.text: Many people think a big company planned Minecraft.

lxc_984b998ee2712398.text: In fact, it began with one man.

lxc_ef40255e41d65251.text: Markus Persson created the first Minecraft, and he wrote it in Java, a computer language.

lxc_64cff9e78c915292.text: Persson did not start from nothing.

lxc_e9bb5eff705833d3.text: In April 2009, another game called Infiniminer came out.

lxc_9f6156c54a18f43d.text: It gave Persson ideas for his own early project, called RubyDung.

lxc_896f0d8e4ac145db.text: Infiniminer influenced three important things: the blocky look, the first-person view, and the building with blocks.

lxc_d4989f63b9aea133.text: In a first-person view, you see the world through the eyes of your character.

lxc_83fcd9b6f5388812.text: The exact early dates are not completely certain.

lxc_2ea91da5054f81bf.text: But the usual story is this: in May 2009, the game began as Cave Game.

lxc_68f87999d25fdd0b.text: In December 2009, it entered a stage called Indev.

lxc_998510585c3f4e3d.text: Then, in June 2010, it entered the Alpha stage.

lxc_bb56446bb23a3639.text: So Minecraft did not appear as a finished product.

lxc_101cf44413f42fbd.text: It borrowed good ideas from another game and slowly became something new.

lxc_13b5fec4e3cbdacc.text: Minecraft grew step by step, in public.

lxc_cbc018f5d979b770.text: Each stage, from Cave Game to Indev to Alpha, was a new and better version.

lxc_ff0a633ea7f0869b.text: Then, in 2011, the full game came out.

lxc_9a5ccc38075ed562.text: After the full release, something important changed.

lxc_4b9c617f9ef5fc8b.text: On 1 December 2011, Persson stepped down as lead developer.

lxc_c6ed437ddd97caad.text: He gave control to Jens Bergensten.

lxc_41ae825b4e83beaa.text: This means the game did not depend on its creator anymore.

lxc_b8c7376b215345cc.text: A team could now carry it forward.

lxc_b56314da15d5b9e4.text: The game kept growing after that.

lxc_1176495fea3114ba.text: In 2012, adventure mode and command blocks arrived.

lxc_d412c6456ced8734.text: With these tools, players could create their own maps with their own rules and challenges, and share them with others.

lxc_95f7591cb3a77414.text: So players were not only playing the game.

lxc_2344b7da9b948114.text: They were also making new games inside it.

lxc_25152114f40f713e.text: A game that only one person controls can stop when that person leaves.

lxc_4b8cc235878d9e46.text: Minecraft moved from one creator to a team, and also gave players tools to create.

lxc_d8a5da2dc63c120e.text: Now we come back to the common idea that Microsoft made Minecraft.

lxc_9e82c02a0c97140b.text: In November 2014, Microsoft bought Mojang, the company behind the game.

lxc_dfc1886716ad9044.text: It also bought the rights to Minecraft as an idea and a product.

lxc_2eda9ce846182b36.text: The price was 2.5 billion US dollars.

lxc_11eab30ffebfc41e.text: The full game came out in 2011.

lxc_19c1f06b592c5010.text: So Microsoft did not create the success.

lxc_9424754107010039.text: It paid for a game that was already successful.

lxc_c0f061a2b883858e.text: That is why the price was so high.

lxc_8474d8464ce1a511.text: A company does not pay billions for an untested idea.

lxc_03fdc9435f8c4561.text: It pays for something that people already love.

lxc_6f7a358c91e362fb.text: Minecraft has sold over 400 million copies.

lxc_6763e89cea67d9b9.text: It is the best-selling video game ever.

lxc_97433471660b7008.text: Even before the full release in 2011, it had sold more than four million copies.

lxc_5a0c791c5264793c.text: Some things certainly helped the game become famous.

lxc_082e81f0a62359db.text: People shared it on social media.

lxc_785bfc74c8ad89f3.text: Fans made funny copies of it.

lxc_9fa435e91bd965d1.text: There were other versions of the game, products to buy, and fan meetings called Minecon.

lxc_bbac4241ec82d272.text: All of these spread the name of the game.

lxc_f3aa78782eab3eb9.text: Many people say Minecraft sold so well because of its freedom.

lxc_155369fdf4119e52.text: That is a reasonable idea, because the game has no required goals and lets you build, explore and survive.

lxc_31bdbaf4fac57172.text: So we need to separate two things.

lxc_2d65c25bba2876b7.text: We know the sales number, because people counted the copies.

lxc_fcbbd943a0fdb1cb.text: We do not know all the reasons for the sales.

lxc_96d509b10c825d8d.text: When someone gives a reason, we should ask: can they show it, or are they guessing?
